[EXPERIMENTAL] Approve a change request.

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] Approve a change request

This command shows what the change request proposes and asks for confirmation, then approves
its latest revision. For an update request, it shows the draft's diff. For an open request,
it shows who is asking to open the environment and for how long. Use `env approval get` to
see how many approvals are still required.


```
pulumi env approval approve <change-request-id> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # Approve a change request
  pulumi env approval approve <change-request-id>

  # Approve with a comment
  pulumi env approval approve <change-request-id> -m "Looks good"

  # Show the proposed change without approving it
  pulumi env approval approve <change-request-id> --dry-run
```

## Options

```
      --dry-run          show the proposed change without approving it
  -h, --help             help for approve
  -m, --message string   a comment to add with the approval
  -y, --yes              skip the confirmation prompt
```
